headwords: ngây thơ như con cầy tơ

flags.why: This is a derogatory label expressing contempt for someone who pretends to be virtuous, as illustrated in [Vietnamese usage](https://www.vanchuongviet.org/index.php?action=detail&comp=tacpham&id=8787).
The entry omits the common literal meaning of falling backward onto one's back.
flags.fix: Add: verb | to fall backward onto one's back; example: Anh ấy trượt chân và ngã ngửa. = He slipped and fell onto his back.
